notes: "The asset library matters especially for scientific talks. A structure image, another view, source data and attribution will often be used again. If those materials exist only in a conversation or scattered files, the next edit loses its foundation. Here they belong to the project and remain available. The alternate 1BNA view on the right comes from the same coordinates, preserving a connection to the evidence.\n\nSource: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1BNA ; https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.78.4.2179 . Source coordinates, calculation and all twelve values: sources/science/."
